days.label: Push Day ? Chest, Shoulders & Triceps
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + arm circles + band pull-aparts

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Five weeks. Five straight weeks at 135 with zero logs. Not a single set recorded. I have no idea if you're showing up, grinding through it, or skipping entirely ? and that's the problem. 135 stays until you prove otherwise, and at this point that proof is overdue. Touch the chest, full 1-second pause at the bottom, drive through the heels, stay braced the entire set. Need 9-10 reps across all three sets at RPE 7 or lower to earn 140. Log every set, every rep, every RPE. This is the hill.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Five weeks at 45 with no logs. The last real data ? 10/9/8 at RPE 8/8/8 ? is so old it barely counts anymore. 30-degree incline, elbows at 45 degrees, 2-second negative on every rep. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 50. The late-set rep drop is the pattern to break ? you can't diagnose it without showing up and writing it down.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Still at 35 ? five weeks, no logs. Last known session had 8/8/8 at RPE 9/9/9, which means you were at your limit every single set. That's not owning the weight ? that's surviving it. Press straight up, full lockout at the top, no lean back, breathe at the top between reps. Check your seat height and starting position before the first rep ? RPE 9 often means setup is off. Need all three sets at RPE 7-8 before we touch the number.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping back from Lateral Raise this week. Lateral raise was in last week, front raise returns now to keep the shoulder rotation balanced. Raise to shoulder height, slight elbow bend, hold for a half-second at the top, 2-second controlled negative on the way down. Alternate arms or do both together ? your call. Don't rock or use momentum. Pick a weight where 10-12 reps is RPE 7 and log it.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.notes: Still at 95 ? five weeks with no logs. The data that earned 100 lbs (10/10/10 at RPE 7/7/7) is now ancient history. I can't bump weight I can't confirm. Hands shoulder-width, elbows tucked tight throughout, lower to the chest, full lockout on every rep. Log this session and 100 lbs is yours next Monday. Five weeks of waiting on this one ? just log it.

exercises.name: Tricep Rope Pushdown
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension this week. Overhead extension was in last week with no log. Rope attachment on the cable, elbows pinned to your sides throughout, push down and split the rope at the bottom for full extension, controlled return ? don't let the stack pull your elbows up. Pick a weight where 10-12 reps is RPE 7 and log it. Baseline session.

days.cooldown: Stretch chest, shoulders, and triceps ? 5 min

days.label: Pull Day ? Back, Biceps & Rear Delts
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + band pull-aparts + cat-cow stretches

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.notes: Five weeks at 195. Five weeks of silence. Last real data ? 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/9 ? told me set 3 was already falling apart, and I have had nothing since. Lats tight before you break the floor, bar dragging up the shins, big breath and brace before every single rep, full lockout at the top. Take the full 2 minutes between sets ? don't rush and then wonder why set 3 crumbles. Need 8+ reps on all three sets at RPE 7 or lower to earn 205. Log it.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Still at 110 ? five weeks without a single log. Last session was 10/9/8 at RPE 7/8/8 ? set 1 solid, sets 2 and 3 losing reps and climbing in effort. Wide grip, pull to upper chest, hard lat squeeze at the bottom, stay upright ? do not let your torso row it down. The set-to-set drop-off is the thing to fix. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 120. Log every set.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Dumbbell Single-Arm Row this week. DB row was in last week with no log. Barbell bent-over row: hinge at the hips, back flat and parallel to the floor, pull the bar to your lower chest or upper abdomen, squeeze the lats at the top. Don't let your torso rise to meet the bar ? the bar comes to you. Pick a weight where 8-10 reps is RPE 7 and log it. Baseline session.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.notes: Still at 70 ? five weeks of no logs. Last known session was 12/12/12 at RPE 7/8/8 ? set 1 clean, sets 2 and 3 climbing in effort. Rope at upper pulley, pull to your face, thumbs pointing behind you at the finish, elbows high throughout, full external rotation at the end. Need 15/15/15 at RPE 7 to earn 75. Push the rep count on every set ? you've had the strength for this for weeks.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Curl
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Hammer Curl this week. Hammer curl was in last week with no log. EZ bar strict curl: elbows pinned to your sides, no swinging, full curl to the top, 2-second controlled negative. The EZ bar is easier on the wrists than a straight bar ? use the inner grip. Pick a weight where 8-10 reps is RPE 7 and log it. Baseline session.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.notes: Five weeks of this sitting here with no log. I said last week that if you didn't log it I'd assign a starting weight ? and you didn't log it. So here it is: start at 25 lbs. If that's too easy, great ? log it and tell me, and we'll adjust immediately. If it's too hard, log it and tell me. Elbows pinned, supinate at the top, 2-second negative. The weight doesn't matter as much as the data. Give me something to work with.

days.cooldown: Stretch lats, biceps, and upper back ? 5 min

days.label: Leg Day ? Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes & Core
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + bodyweight squats + leg swings

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.notes: Five weeks at 165. Five weeks without a single log. Last real data was 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8 ? stuck at 8 reps, stuck at RPE 8, and that was weeks ago. Below parallel, big breath before you unrack, brace hard, drive through the heels, chest up out of the hole. Take the full 2 minutes between sets. Need 9-10 reps on all three sets at RPE 7 or under to earn 175. Show up. Do the work. Log it.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Still at 155 ? five weeks, no logs. Last session was 10/9/10 at RPE 7/8/8 ? set 1 great, sets 2 and 3 losing reps and climbing in effort. Slight knee bend, hips back, bar close to the legs the whole way down, feel the hamstring stretch at the bottom, don't round the lower back. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 165. Rest the full 90 seconds between sets ? that's where sets 2 and 3 fall apart.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunges
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Bulgarian Split Squat this week. Split squat was in last week with no log. Walking lunges: long stride for glute emphasis, short stride for quad emphasis ? pick one and stay consistent. Dumbbells at your sides, front knee tracks over your toes, back knee nearly touches the floor, drive through the front heel. Pick a weight where 10-12 reps per leg is RPE 7 and log it. Baseline session.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Still at 85 ? five weeks of no logs. Last session was 12/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8 ? set 1 hit 12 but sets 2 and 3 fell to 10 with high effort throughout. Upper back on the bench, barbell padded across your hips, drive through the heels, full hip extension at the top, squeeze hard for a full second, controlled descent. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 to earn 90. Rest the full 75 seconds between sets.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Leg Curl this week. Leg curl was in last week with no log. Leg extension on the leg attachment: full extension at the top, squeeze the quads hard for a full second, controlled 2-second negative on the way down ? don't let the weight drop. Pick a weight where 12-15 reps is RPE 7 and log it. Baseline session.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.notes: I said last week I'd assign a starting weight if there was no log ? there was no log. Start at 40 lbs. Kneel facing the pulley, rope behind your head, crunch down using your abs ? not your hips, not your arms. The movement comes from your abs contracting, period. If 40 is too easy or too hard, log it and tell me. The data is what matters ? give me something to work with and I'll dial it in immediately.

days.cooldown: Stretch quads, hamstrings, hip flexors ? 5 min
